label: canon-dams-v2-n1
_why: THE FIRST CENTURY RUN OF THE REDESIGNED DAMS (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.89.9, FINDINGS F169; user 2026-09-26 evening: 'If you [have run the probes] and all don't need follow-up probes to resolve ambiguities, go with another n=1'). ARM = config/mod_config.canon-dams.json {kind: config} AT COMMIT 81d13d5: the canon (canon-b164-trade) + the power plant at 1,600 points + 159 dam projects as ONE expandable building each (349 levels), not government-funded, can_build_government reading scope:investor_country, overlord-financed levels in subjects' states (journal entry at 540 per point, then create_building + add_ownership to the overlord), ai_nationalization_desire 0.75, must_have subsidies. No probe settings. Probes p6-p11 established the mechanism; this run answers what the probes could not: whether overlords other than Britain finance at real technology dates, whether any dam level is privatised over decades, and what the redesign does to the economy against the stage design (20260926_154538_canon-dams-n1).
_arm: config/mod_config.canon-dams.json (+ tech_tree_options.canon-dams.json = the canon twin, byte-identical)
_comparison: the stage-design run 20260926_154538_canon-dams-n1 (intact, world GDP 1.02, loss 3.7, 86 surveyed / 81 stages, dams 39% of world electricity at 1935), the canon n=3 (20260926_002930_canon-b164-trade-n3) and the pinned vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149). n=1: DIRECTIONAL only.
_instrument: identical to canon_dams_n1: the canon telemetry + PMR_DAM debug.log lines (survey_*, stage_start, built / complete, finance_start / finance_done, bur_year) + yearly save summaries (building_dam_* per country, ownership levels by owner class).
_stop_rule: fixed n=1: plays to 1936, no stop watcher

_predictions.surveys: about as many as the stage design (70-100 projects surveyed by 1936); first surveys 1875-1890.
_predictions.financing: Britain finances levels in Canada, the Oregon Country / HBC region and India from the 1890s; at least one other overlord (Russia, the Ottomans, France or the Netherlands) finances at least one level by 1936. Canada-type subjects hold far fewer levels than in the stage run (12 there).
_predictions.construction: 60-140 levels built by 1936 (the stage run: 81 stages); dam electricity 25-50% of the world total at 1935; no dam level left partly built for more than 2 years.
_predictions.ownership: every dam level government-owned at 1936 (host or financing overlord); zero privately owned levels.
_predictions.economy: world GDP inside the canon seed spread (0.68-1.04 of vanilla); no hard break attributable to the dams; electricity not pinned at 175% in the majors.
_predictions.perf: play time within 5% of the stage run (178 min)
